params.message:
Forwarded mail for the workbench

Mail forwarded to <slug>@in.abovebeyond.ai arrives through Resend's signed webhook, is kept
only from an owner address with DMARC passing, and is split into the owner's instruction and
the forwarded mail as data. Received mail is read with a key of its own, apart from the
sending key. The shed reads it (read, hand-read) and moves it through the task route under
mail:<id>, the gateway's existing portal.task kind.
